name: Ooe Kagura
source: [url=/c50232]Kousuke's[/url] strange kouhai who is often staring at the sky and occassionally claiming that she is receiving radio waves from the aliens. Kagura is extremely curious about non-scientific things such as fortune telling and magic. She claims that she needs Kousuke's semen in order to perform her magic arts. She is overprotective of her younger sister [url=/c17479]Otoha[/url], and also loves eating her cooking. She also has a sensitive tongue.
